The amphibian displays characteristic glossy black skin with vivid, irregular yellow patches and spots covering its head, back, and limbs. Its body is robust and cylindrical, curving slightly to the left. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands behind small, dark eyes. Short, stout limbs with distinct digits are visible, particularly the front left limb. The tail curves out of frame or is obscured by the body's posture.
